baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins the lunar noun at 84:18 word 1 to the Form VIII event at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The moon is not merely named at a static phase: scattered or uneven constituents close into an even, ordered whole. Fullness is an achieved organization.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the celestial moon and explicitly includes its naming at fullness as the visible bearer of the event.
Supplies joined, even, orderly completion, making lunar fullness a transition into integrated form.

changed_reading.before: An oath by the full moon as a finished object.
changed_reading.after: An oath by the moon at the event of becoming internally joined, even, and complete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb اتسق at 84:18 word 3 can keep the load-bearing and gathering force of و س ق active inside the completion sense.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fullness is construed as taking a dispersed load into one bearer. The moon becomes a gathering vessel rather than only a bright geometric disk.

activation_trace.role: Fixes the bearer as the moon and its light rather than an unanchored container.
Contributes physical bearing of a load, giving fullness weight and capacity.
Contributes gathering and joining dispersed things, providing the load that is taken into unity.

changed_reading.after: The moon has gathered and now bears its dispersed load as one coherent fullness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb's root inventory includes both a fixed load-measure and orderly completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: A measured quantity and a completed form overlap: the moon marks the instant at which accumulation reaches a determinate threshold.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the lunar object whose fullness can function as a visible threshold.
Supplies the wasq as a determinate measure or load, making completion quantized rather than vague.
Converts the reached measure into even and orderly fullness.

changed_reading.before: Fullness is a loose visual description.
changed_reading.after: The moon reaches a measured load-limit at which its form closes into completeness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window begins with an opened fracture and ends with a branch image of mending a crooked break. Between them, the focus moon's completion can act as a visible episode of rejoining after rupture.

activation_trace.role: Provides the visible lunar body on which restored wholeness can appear.
Provides joining into even completion, the reparative middle term of the mechanism.
Supplies an object splitting open, establishing cosmic disjunction before the moon's coherence.
Supplies mending a crooked fracture, sharpening completion into repair rather than mere growth.

structural_cues: 84:1 opens the window with the sky splitting; 84:25 closes it with the reward-root's repair image.
84:18 places an evenly joined celestial body inside that fracture-to-mending span.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fracture, lunar joining, and mending; I supply the arc fracture -> visible rejoining -> repair. A live alternative is that the opening rupture and closing recompense remain independent of the lunar image.

changed_reading.after: The moon's fullness momentarily images a broken order drawn back into a fitted whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated receptive hearing, lordly bringing-to-completion, and fitting a thing to its proper place activate اتسق as responsive conformity. The moon's order reads as an answered ordering, not autonomous self-decoration.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the moon's joined, even completion as the resulting ordered state.
Supplies receptive listening and acceptance, giving order a responsive rather than mechanical character.
Supplies tending, correction, and bringing to completion as a possible source of the lunar order.
Supplies a thing fitting its proper joint or vessel, specifying completion as exact placement.

structural_cues: The receptive-and-due formula occurs for the sky at 84:2 and the earth at 84:5.
The focus then presents another celestial state through a verb of orderly completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceptance, formative completion, exact fit, and lunar order; I infer a governance arrow from response to fitted form. Alternatively, the repeated formula may govern only sky and earth while 84:18 remains a temporal observation.

changed_reading.before: The moon happens to become full through an impersonal cycle.
changed_reading.after: The moon answers into its proper fit and completed measure within a wider responsive order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is extended, casts out what it held, and becomes empty; the moon gathers and bears. Fullness therefore participates in a redistribution pattern in which one cosmic body unloads while another concentrates.

activation_trace.role: Identifies the receiving or concentrating body as the moon.
Supplies bearing a load, making the focus fullness capacitive.
Supplies concentration of dispersed material into one gathered state.
Supplies drawing the earth out lengthwise, opening spatial capacity before unloading.
Supplies casting an interior load outward, the inverse motion to lunar gathering.
Supplies bareness and an emptied place as the terminal state of unloading.

structural_cues: 84:3-4 moves earth through extension, expulsion, and vacancy.
84:18 reverses that vector through bearing, gathering, and fullness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed load-vectors; I infer a redistribution relation between them, not a literal transfer of terrestrial contents to the moon. The live alternative is a formal contrast between emptying and filling with no shared material flow.

changed_reading.before: Lunar fullness is isolated from the terrestrial transformations.
changed_reading.after: The moon's fullness is the concentrating pole of a scene elsewhere stretching, discharging, and emptying.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joining items into a record and counting them activates the measured branch of و س ق. The full moon becomes a total assembled from increments and brought to account.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the visible lunar total and its association with fullness.
Supplies a determinate load-measure, turning fullness into a countable threshold.
Supplies the joining of dispersed units that precedes totaling.
Supplies joining one item to another, making the record an assembled rather than atomic object.
Supplies counting and accounting, which closes the gathered units into a total.

structural_cues: 84:7 presents an assembled book and 84:8 immediately presents its reckoning.
The focus root can denote both gathering and a fixed measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, accounting, gathering, and measure; I supply the arrow increments -> assembled record -> reached total. Alternatively, the lunar measure may remain a concrete lexical residue without an accounting function.

changed_reading.before: The moon grows full without an evaluative register.
changed_reading.after: The moon reaches a reckoned total: dispersed increments have been joined, measured, and closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reversal and return/decrease combine with the branch image of the crescent disappearing at month's end. Fullness ceases to be a terminus and becomes an apex already carrying its coming reversal.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the moon and its naming at fullness, locating the apex within a lunar cycle.
Supplies the fully even state that can function as the cycle's turning threshold.
Supplies turning a thing away from its current face, converting completion into incipient reversal.
Supplies the crescent's concealment at month's end, explicitly extending the focus moon beyond fullness toward disappearance.
Supplies return together with decrease, giving the post-full turn a directional lunar analogue.

structural_cues: 84:9 and 84:13 repeat glad return/home language around the contrary claim at 84:14 that there will be no return.
84:18 names lunar completion immediately before the assertion of successive states at 84:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lunar fullness, reversal, lunar concealment, and return/decrease; I infer apex -> turn -> waning/concealment. A live alternative keeps ق ل ب and ح و ر exclusively on human return and treats the lunar branch as a contextual echo.

changed_reading.before: Fullness is the moon's final achieved state.
changed_reading.after: Fullness is a temporary apex whose perfection already contains the turn toward decrease and concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Red twilight thins into night; night gathers what it covers; then the moon itself becomes integrated. The repeated root shifts gathering from an external field to the gathered body's own completion.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the moon and its full luminosity as the final visible body in the dusk-night sequence.
Supplies inward completion into an even order at the second occurrence of the root.
Supplies the red remainder at sunset, the first transitional band before night gathers.
Supplies darkness opposed to day as the encompassing field of the first gathering.
Supplies night gathering dispersed things externally, setting up the focus verse's more inward integration.

structural_cues: 84:16-18 is a contiguous sequence of twilight, night and what it gathers, then the moon when ittasqa.
The same root occurs transitively at 84:17 and in an intransitive/reflexive form at 84:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the color-to-darkness sequence, repeated و س ق, external gathering, and self-completion; I infer an inward scalar shift field gathers contents -> moon gathers into itself. Alternatively, the repetition may only intensify nocturnal description without distinguishing two levels.

changed_reading.before: Night and full moon are adjacent oath objects.
changed_reading.after: Night performs first-order gathering, while the moon performs second-order self-integration inside the gathered night.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stacking, mounting, and state-after-state convert the complete disk from destination into one traversed layer. Completion remains real but is locally complete inside a larger succession.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the moon at fullness as the concrete completed state to be relativized.
Supplies genuine local completion rather than an incomplete intermediate fragment.
Supplies one thing riding or stacking above another, making states compositional.
Supplies multiple layers above one another as the architecture of succession.
Supplies one condition after another, translating spatial layering into temporal passage.

structural_cues: 84:19 follows the completed moon without an intervening verse.
The doubled طبق construction explicitly serializes conditions immediately after lunar completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a completed lunar state followed by mounted layers and condition-after-condition; I infer that the moon models locally complete but traversable stages. Alternatively, 84:19 may address human transitions without making the moon one of them.

changed_reading.after: Fullness is one complete layer that must itself be ridden through into another condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathered recitation and inward containment transfer coherence from geometry to meaning: like the complete moon, a whole can be made by collecting units and holding them within.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the visible completed surface against which inwardly held coherence can be read.
Supplies collection and joining of dispersed units, shared by physical and semantic wholes.
Supplies gathering and assembly within the recitation root, activating a semantic kind of collected whole.
Supplies holding meaning together in the heart, moving gatheredness into an interior register.
Supplies a vessel containing an object, preserving a material container analogue for inward coherence.

structural_cues: 84:21 presents collected recitation and 84:23 names what people inwardly contain.
Both follow the moon whose focus verb already joins dispersed things.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three kinds of collection: lunar, recitational, and inward/container-like; I infer that visible fullness can model hidden coherence. Alternatively, these are independent root echoes and the moon remains only a physical whole.

changed_reading.before: The moon's integration is exclusively visual and external.
changed_reading.after: The moon becomes a visible analogue for units gathered and held as an inwardly coherent whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus moon reaches a completed but cyclically bounded state; the closing negation excludes cutting and depletion from the reward. Lunar fullness therefore clarifies the difference between complete-for-now and uncut continuation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a fullness that belongs to a changing lunar object and is therefore visibly bounded.
Supplies real completion, allowing boundedness without denying wholeness.
Supplies negation and exception, operating on the following cutoff image rather than adding another finite state.
Supplies cutting or diminution until extension stops, the condition explicitly excluded from the reward.

structural_cues: 84:18 presents a completed celestial phase; 84:25 ends the window by negating cutoff from recompense.
84:19's successive states keeps lunar completion inside change, while 84:25 names continuation without depletion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite lunar completion, succession, a negator, and cutoff; I infer a contrast bounded wholeness vs uncut duration. A live alternative is that غير ممنون qualifies reward without retrospectively changing the lunar oath.

changed_reading.before: Every completion is implicitly final and enduring.
changed_reading.after: The moon exemplifies a whole that is complete yet bounded, making uncut continuance a distinct and stronger category.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun is plainly celestial while its inventory's gambling branch is form-distant. It remains anchored by that exact focus branch, the focus root's fixed measure, and the nearby accounting and lot-gambling images. Render only as a latent lexical echo of stakes becoming settled, never as the verse's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ق م ر itself carries a gambling/defeat branch, while اتسق carries measure and closure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies gambling, contest, and an outcome won through play or deception as the odd focus-side activation.
Supplies a fixed measure in which dispersed stakes can be totaled and settled.
Supplies the explicit accounting operation that fixes the contest's total.
Supplies lots, gambling, and division of the stake, directly resonating with the remote focus branch.

changed_reading.before: The lunar disk reaches neutral physical fullness.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory echo, gathered measure becomes the instant when a risky contest's lots and stakes resolve into a fixed outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The outlier reverses the expected equation of moonlight with disclosure, so it is easy to lose in a smooth reading. It remains anchored in the focus moon's exact snow-whiteness/bewildered-sight branch and is activated by seeing and covering in context. Downstream prose should qualify it as a perceptual paradox, not claim literal snow or blindness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moon's branch inventory includes sight bewildered by extreme whiteness, while the verb marks maximal completion.

activation_trace.role: Supplies vision confused by overwhelming whiteness, making maximum luminosity capable of occluding perception.
Supplies maximal even fullness, the intensity threshold at which disclosure can reverse into overload.
Supplies direct ocular seeing, activating the focus branch's question of what brightness does to sight.
Supplies covering, allowing perceptual obscurity to coexist with a fully exposed luminous surface.

changed_reading.before: A full moon simply makes the night easier to see.
changed_reading.after: Completed brightness can disclose the field yet overwhelm the observer, so visibility and recognition diverge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is odd because it activates an obscure waterskin sense beneath an unmistakably celestial noun. It remains valid as an exploratory activation because the focus branch itself describes damage between skin layers and context adds inward wound-filling, surface, and pain. Render as a qualified warning that apparent integration may hide damage, never as a lexical replacement for moon.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moon inventory includes a waterskin spoiled between its layers under moonlight-like burning, while اتسق supplies the apparently integrated exterior.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a moon-damaged waterskin whose trouble develops between outer layers, anchoring hidden material spoilage in the focus root.
Supplies the smooth completed appearance that can mask rather than reveal layered damage.
Supplies a wound filling internally, intensifying the image of harmful accumulation beneath closure.
Supplies visible skin and surface, distinguishing outward brightness from what its layers contain.
Supplies pain as the latent consequence concealed beneath an apparently whole surface.

changed_reading.before: Even fullness guarantees soundness throughout the object.
changed_reading.after: An integrated bright surface may still carry damaging accumulation between its layers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the oath's serene fullness through pursuit and vulnerability. It remains focus-anchored in the moonlight-hunting branch and gains support from night-activity and sight cues. Render only as a secondary ecological/social affordance of full light: illumination can expose prey as well as guide observers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ق م ر inventory explicitly includes approaching or hunting by moonlight, including prey whose sight is overwhelmed by nocturnal light.

activation_trace.role: Supplies nocturnal approach and hunting under moonlight, turning brightness into an affordance with unequal risks.
Supplies full and even luminosity as the point of maximum nocturnal exposure.
Supplies deliberate activity undertaken at night, activating the behavioral side of moonlight rather than scenery alone.
Supplies ocular seeing, making asymmetries of watcher, hunter, and exposed target part of the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The completed moon is a benign object of contemplation.
changed_reading.after: Completed moonlight reorganizes nocturnal agency: it enables pursuit and can expose or bewilder what is seen.

strongest_changes: The repeated و س ق in 84:17-18 changes generic fullness into nested gathering: night gathers a field, then the moon integrates itself within it.
Reversal, lunar concealment, and return/decrease change fullness from an endpoint into a turning apex.
Book-joining and reckoning activate fullness as a measured total assembled from increments.
The opening fracture and closing mending image let lunar integration coexist with a reparative reading.
Successive mounted layers make the full moon locally complete but still traversable rather than final.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root inventories support several simultaneous mechanics: geometric integration, load-bearing collection, calibrated measure, cyclical reversal, and hazardous exposure. Context does not collapse them; it makes the same full disk alternately a repaired whole, a reckoned total, an inward container, a transit layer, and an overbright surface that may conceal or produce vulnerability.
remaining_uncertainties: The redistribution arrow between the emptying earth and gathering moon may be causal only at the level of composition, not shared material.
The gambling, damaged-waterskin, and hunting activations are packet-anchored but may remain lexical echoes too distant for anything beyond qualified exploratory prose.
Cyclical apex and layered forward transit pull in different temporal directions; both remain live because each has a distinct traceable mechanism.
Responsive conformity may describe the whole cosmic sequence, or the listening formula may apply only to sky and earth without governing the moon.
